label: topology-countability
tail:
A1 and A2 are complete for the wave-5 `topology-countability` batch. Three files written, no item file touched.

## What I found

**No fatal defect.** All 73 items, all 191 proof steps, and every dependency citation were read against the on-disk text of 84 external targets. Zero undeclared wikilinks, zero `depcheck`/`citecheck` hits on my scope, `precheck` 53/53, all 22 source URLs return 200.

**A1 — provenance** (73 rows): 13 `literature-derived`/`exact-source`, 49 `ai-altered`/`semantic-source`, 7 `established-knowledge`, 4 `ai-generated`/`trivial`. No item carries a legacy `authorship` line, so the A4 retag is purely additive and voids no judge stamp.

The pleasant surprise is **Fremlin's §5A4**, cited bare on 14 items: it is an *exact* source, and in the library's own raw no-ℵ₀-normalisation convention. 5A4A defines `w`, `d`, `χ(x,X)`, `χ(X)`, `L(X)` and `c(X)` verbatim; its closing Remark is an exact source for all five equivalences of `cor-cardinal-functions-detect-countability-axioms` at once; and 5A4B(b), (c) and (h)(i) are exact for the subspace inequalities, the continuous-image inequalities, and `d(X) = w(X)` for metrizable spaces.

The four `ai-generated` calls are chart/wrapper items with the verification written out, and I confirmed all four have **zero `deps` consumers corpus-wide**, so the label seeds nothing into `genrisk`.

**A2 — proof contracts**: 53 items, 231 citation contracts, 191 step contracts, 424 boundary dispositions. `proof-contract.mjs --strict` reports **0 errors, 0 warnings**. I've flagged in the findings that the structural half was extracted mechanically from the item text and re-verified by the gate, while the claim that each quoted clause *licenses* its step is my reading — a substring test establishes no implication.

**N1 is the one finding I'd actually act on.** Twelve items cite the UCR topology notes as their only reference for material that document never mentions — it contains no occurrence of "countable chain condition", "ccc", Δ-system, Sorgenfrey/lower-limit, one-point compactification, ω₁ or Cantor cube. Same class as the sibling Beta's N6. I located and HTTP-verified replacements that carry each clause. Adding a reference changes no claim, so it rides the single A4 stage snapshot with the retags. (One more instance: `rem-euclidean-topology-dictionary` cites Munkres §§19–20 via the Wikipedia article about the *person*.)

Eight nonfatal observations follow (N2–N9), all with "no repair" recommended and reasons given — the sharpest being **N2**, where `cor-components-of-open-subsets-of-rn-are-polygonally-connected` uses "path-connected ⇒ connected" without declaring `thm-path-connected-implies-connected`, though its sibling corollary does for the identical inference.

Eight items are escalated to Alpha for their evidence class, not their mathematics — chiefly the five well-definedness lemmas (no source proves them separately because in the source's setting they are immediate) and `thm-basic-cardinal-function-inequalities`, where Fremlin 5A4B(a) is exact for three of four inequalities but **`L(X) ≤ w(X)` is not in it**, which is why the item is `ai-altered` rather than `literature-derived`.

`risk-report.mjs` routes 18 CRITICAL and 20 HIGH for Alpha `risk_review`; I found no defect in any of them. Next action is A3.
